findings.message: Some outlines have fewer than 3 corners, so they cannot enclose an area.
findings.hint: Remove those outlines or add the missing corners.

findings.message: Some polygons have no outline at all, so they cannot be drawn.
findings.hint: Remove those polygons or give each one an outline.

findings.message: The coordinate reference system is missing, so the positions have no meaning on the Earth.
findings.hint: Choose a coordinate system by its EPSG code (a number such as 32640), or choose a local grid and its units.
